rationale: A is false because heat release need not lower temperature during a phase change; C is false because separated mirror surfaces do not reunite under ordinary conditions despite intermolecular attraction. B is also false as written: specific heat capacity depends on the material and its state/phase, not material kind alone. D can be true because total internal energy and temperature are different quantities; heat transfer follows temperature difference, so a lower-internal-energy hotter small object can transfer energy to a larger, higher-internal-energy cooler object. The source key BD is therefore wrong under the literal wording; revise the answer to D and give a direct explanation instead of retaining BD as an unresolved candidate.
